text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hoh. A retreat for the three of us, is 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Assuming our schedules match up, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Pardon my intrusion, but... you have 
seemed exceptionally busy even on your 
days off lately, and it appeared your 
fatigue had not fully faded.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I would love to propose a plan for a 
retreat to soothe both body and mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't need it. ...Besides, this group is 
way too bizarre for a trip.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I go to ask for advice, the two 
of you are often together. And you often 
coach us together on the track too...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I thought that for friends as close as you 
two, it would make for a much more 
refreshing trip.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...I see. So that's how it looks to you."
